notes: Auto DJ transitions with per-band EQ and filters (bass swap, filter blend, quick cut, picked by tempo, key and energy); crossfade of 6 s and longer is shaped too. Endless set from a crate or a list. Online tracklists open as a set page with an Add to library button, recordings are read from the tracklist page (1001Tracklists, MixesDB). One merged 'sets with this track' list with Show all. Find a recording asks the page first. Karaoke counts down to the first line. Waveform fits the Paper theme. Search everything from a set page goes to results.
